structure.title: School structure
structure.description: Manage grade levels, tracks, and school rooms.

years.title: Academic years
years.description: Manage the school's academic years: create, edit, activate, or archive.
years.emptyBody: Create the first academic year to start managing academic data.
years.activateBody: "{label}" will become the active academic year; every other year is deactivated automatically.
years.archiveBody: "{label}" will be archived and no longer shown in the main list.

form.label: Academic year name
form.periodHint: Pick the first day, then the last.
form.periodRequired: Choose the start and end dates.

terms.title: Terms of {year}
terms.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
terms.activateBody: "{name}" becomes the active term; the other terms of this year become inactive.

gradeLevels.searchPlaceholder: Search grade level name or code
gradeLevels.title: Grade levels
gradeLevels.codeRequired: Enter the grade level's code, for example X.
gradeLevels.nameRequired: Enter the grade level's name, for example Grade X.
gradeLevels.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
gradeLevels.applyTemplateBody: Creates the standard grade levels for the education level you pick. Codes that already exist are skipped, not duplicated.
gradeLevels.emptyBody: Add grade levels one at a time, or apply a template for the school's education level.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.description: Student majors or tracks, for example science, social studies or languages in senior high.
tracks.codeRequired: Enter the track's code, for example IPA.
tracks.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
tracks.emptyBody: Add a track if the school offers majors, such as science or social studies.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
rooms.emptyBody: Add rooms so classes can be assigned to one.

subjectOfferings.title: Subjects per academic year
subjectOfferings.saved: Subject saved for the academic year
subjectOfferings.deleted: Subject removed from this academic year
subjectOfferings.deleteTitle: Remove this subject from the academic year?
subjectOfferings.deleteBody: "{name}" will be removed from this academic year.
subjectOfferings.emptyTitle: No subjects for this academic year yet
subjectOfferings.emptyBody: Add the subjects taught in this academic year.

teachingAssignments.title: Teaching assignments
teachingAssignments.description: Replace a teacher's whole subject and class load for one academic year in a single step.
teachingAssignments.noAssignments: This teacher has no subjects assigned for this academic year yet.
teachingAssignments.confirmBody: {teacher} will teach {n, plural, one {# subject} other {# subjects}}, replacing the previous list.
teachingAssignments.emptyBody: Pick an academic year and a teacher to view and manage their teaching assignments.

enrollmentImport.title: Class assignment import
enrollmentImport.description: Download the template, fill in each student's class, then upload it to review before applying.
enrollmentImport.moveExisting: Move students who already have a different class this year
enrollmentImport.partial: Apply valid rows even if some rows have errors
enrollmentImport.prepareBody: Choose the academic year, download its template, fill in each student's class and upload it. The file is reviewed first; nothing is saved yet.
enrollmentImport.partialNote: Valid rows are applied; rows with problems are skipped.
enrollmentImport.blockedNote: While any row has a problem, nothing is applied. Fix the file, or tick the option to apply only the valid rows.

newYearSetup.title: New academic year
newYearSetup.description: Copy subjects and classes from one academic year into another that does not have them yet.
newYearSetup.sameYearError: The source and destination academic years must differ.
newYearSetup.idleBody: Pick the source and destination academic years, then show the plan to see what will be copied.
newYearSetup.emptyBody: The destination academic year already has every subject and class the source year has.
newYearSetup.noOfferings: No subjects in the source academic year.
newYearSetup.noClasses: No classes in the source academic year.
newYearSetup.confirmBody: {offerings} subjects and {classes} classes will be copied.

workspace.pendingSubstitutions: {count, plural, one {# substitution request} other {# substitution requests}}
workspace.yearHelp: Prepare classes and subjects for the destination year, review student promotions, then activate the year when the school is ready. Each step remains available independently.
workspace.journalHelp: Attendance and the journal are saved together for this meeting.
workspace.learningDescription: Manage subjects, lesson periods, teaching assignments and additional duties.

yearFlow.sameYearError: The source and destination years must differ.
yearFlow.needTwoYears: Create the destination year on the Academic years page first.
